articles.title: CCTV Captures Horror as Speeding Truck Rams Woman from Behind, Miraculous Escape in Tumakuru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman narrowly escaped death after a truck lost control and rammed into her from behind at IB Circle in Tiptur town of Karnataka's Tumakuru district on Tuesday morning.

body.html:
A woman narrowly escaped death after a truck lost control and rammed into her from behind at IB Circle in Tiptur town of Karnataka's Tumakuru district on Tuesday morning.

According to police, the woman was walking along the roadside when the speeding truck veered off course and struck her from behind. She sustained injuries and was rushed to a nearby hospital, where she received treatment and was later discharged.

The truck driver also sustained injuries in the incident and was discharged after receiving medical treatment.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to ascertain the circumstances that caused the driver to lose control of the vehicle.

#Karnataka #Tumakuru #Tiptur #RoadAccident #TruckAccident

articles.title: Taxi Driver Seen with Rod, 3-Car Clash Near Dwarka Expressway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A heated road rage confrontation involving the drivers of three cars near the Dwarka Expressway Tunnel in Delhi, captured on video and widely shared on social media, is now under police investigation.

body.html:
A heated road rage confrontation involving the drivers of three cars near the Dwarka Expressway Tunnel in Delhi, captured on video and widely shared on social media, is now under police investigation.

The incident, which took place on Monday evening, allegedly began after a minor collision involving a Wagon R and a white Maruti Ertiga taxi. A video of the altercation shows the taxi driver holding a wooden rod, grabbing the Wagon R driver by the collar, and shouting at him on the Dwarka Expressway. The driver of a Kia Seltos also stopped his vehicle nearby, stepped out, and became involved in the argument.

According to police, a PCR call regarding the incident was received at around 7.44 pm on July 7.

Police said the caller alleged that the taxi driver attempted to assault him with a stick following the collision. In self-defence, the caller reportedly pushed the taxi driver, who then fell against a parked Kia Seltos, causing minor damage to the vehicle.

The owner of the Kia Seltos allegedly stopped the Wagon R driver and sought compensation for the damage, while the taxi driver reportedly fled the scene.

PCR personnel reached the spot and were informed that the taxi driver had already left. Police said the Wagon R driver and the Kia Seltos owner later resolved the matter between themselves.

The caller subsequently informed police that he had returned home, the issue had been settled mutually, and he did not wish to pursue any legal action.

Police said efforts are underway to trace the caller, while CCTV footage from the area is being examined to identify the taxi driver and verify the sequence of events.

#Delhi #RoadRage #DwarkaExpressway #ViralVideo #DelhiPolice

articles.title: Panic as Two-Storey Wada Collapses in Somwar Peth, Major Tragedy Averted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A two-storey traditional house (wada) collapsed in Dhangar Galli, Somwar Peth, triggering panic among local residents and raising concerns over the safety of ageing buildings in the area.

body.html:
A two-storey traditional house (wada) collapsed in Dhangar Galli, Somwar Peth, triggering panic among local residents and raising concerns over the safety of ageing buildings in the area.

The Fire Brigade responded swiftly to the incident, secured the area, and prevented any further danger, averting a potentially major tragedy.

Rescue teams immediately launched a search operation and confirmed that no one was trapped beneath the debris. Fortunately, no injuries or fatalities were reported.

Authorities have begun inspecting the collapsed structure and nearby buildings to assess potential safety risks and prevent similar incidents. The exact cause of the collapse is yet to be determined, and further investigation is underway.

#Pune #SomwarPeth #BuildingCollapse #BreakingNews

articles.title: Family Allegedly Attacked by Gang After Complaining About Late-Night Nuisance in Anantapur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A family in Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur has alleged that they were attacked by a group of around 20 men after complaining about late-night drinking and public nuisance near their house.

body.html:
A family in Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur has alleged that they were attacked by a group of around 20 men after complaining about late-night drinking and public nuisance near their house.

According to the family, Rajesh and Uma Maheshwari had complained to their landlord after a local youth, identified as Tabrej, and his friends were allegedly drinking and creating a disturbance outside their home in Hamali Colony. They claimed that after being warned, Tabrej allegedly returned with a group of men, who attacked their house late at night.

The couple alleged that despite informing the group that there were children inside the house, the attackers assaulted Uma Maheshwari and also threw petrol at the house. They managed to shut the doors, following which the group left the spot.

Police arrested two individuals, Shafi and Hasan, who were remanded to custody on July 3, 2026. Investigators stated that while alcohol was consumed, they found no evidence of ganja use at the time.

The couple has lodged a police complaint but alleged that cases were registered against only two of the accused while the others were let off. They further claimed they are receiving death threats and have appealed to the police for protection and justice.

#Anantapur #AndhraPradesh #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: College Students Trapped Midway at Mallalli Falls After Crossing Barricade
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A group of college students stranded in a dangerous section of Mallalli Falls in Karnataka's Kodagu (Coorg) district were rescued in a dramatic operation by Fire and Emergency Services personnel with the help of local residents on Monday.

body.html:
A group of college students stranded in a dangerous section of Mallalli Falls in Karnataka's Kodagu (Coorg) district were rescued in a dramatic operation by Fire and Emergency Services personnel with the help of local residents on Monday.

According to reports, the students allegedly crossed a safety barricade and entered a restricted area near the middle of the waterfall.

As the water flow suddenly intensified, they were unable to return to safety and took shelter on a rock in the middle of the falls, leaving them trapped amid the gushing water.

Visuals from the scene showed two of the stranded students standing on a rock surrounded by fast-flowing water while waiting for rescue.

After receiving information, Fire and Emergency Services personnel rushed to the spot. With assistance from local residents, they carried out a challenging rescue operation and safely brought all the students to safety.

The incident comes amid intense monsoon conditions across Karnataka.

In a separate incident on July 1, three members of a family, including two girls, were killed in a rain-triggered landslide that destroyed a house in the Nagori area of Mangaluru. Three others were rescued after a large mass of soil from a nearby hill collapsed following heavy overnight rainfall, burying the house under debris.

articles.title: Landslide Hits Wayanad Tunnel Project Site, Rescue Teams Race to Find Workers Feared Trapped
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A landslide struck the Anakkompoyil-Meppadi tunnel project site at Kalladi near Meppady in Kerala's Wayanad district on Tuesday, triggering fears that several people may be trapped under the debris, officials said.

body.html:
A landslide struck the Anakkompoyil-Meppadi tunnel project site at Kalladi near Meppady in Kerala's Wayanad district on Tuesday, triggering fears that several people may be trapped under the debris, officials said.

The incident occurred near Meenakshi Bridge, where work on the tunnel project connecting Malappuram and Wayanad districts is currently underway.

Teams from the Fire and Rescue Services, police and the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) rushed to the spot and launched search and rescue operations. Fire and Rescue Services personnel from Kalpetta are also participating in the operation.

Officials said local residents rescued three people from the site, where workers associated with the tunnel project were staying. The affected area also includes a few houses and homestays.

Authorities are verifying whether more people remain trapped beneath the debris. Minister T. Siddique and the Wayanad District Collector are monitoring the rescue operation at the site.

The Anakkompoyil-Meppadi tunnel project, which aims to improve connectivity between Malappuram and Wayanad districts, began last year.

The incident comes nearly two years after the devastating landslides that struck Wayanad in July 2024, when torrential rainfall triggered multiple slope failures in the Meppadi region, killing more than 400 people, leaving several others missing and causing widespread destruction in villages including Chooralmala and Mundakkai.

articles.title: Viral Video Shows Water Leaking From Banaras Railway Station Roof During Heavy Rain
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Heavy rainfall lashed Varanasi on Monday, July 6, following which a video showing water leaking from the roof of Platform No. 8 at Banaras Railway Station went viral on social media, raising questions over the station's maintenance.

body.html:
Heavy rainfall lashed Varanasi on Monday, July 6, following which a video showing water leaking from the roof of Platform No. 8 at Banaras Railway Station went viral on social media, raising questions over the station's maintenance.

The video, recorded by a passenger during the downpour, shows water dripping from the platform shelter, causing inconvenience to commuters waiting at the station.

Following the viral video, the railway administration issued a clarification, stating that the valley gutter above the platform shelter is cleaned regularly.

According to railway officials, heavy rain and strong winds caused leaves and kite strings to accumulate at the junction of the downpipe and the valley gutter on Platform No. 8. The blockage temporarily prevented proper drainage, resulting in water leaking from the shelter.

The Railways said station officials were immediately informed, and the obstruction was cleared, restoring normal drainage.

Banaras Railway Station is regarded as one of the cleanest and best-equipped railway stations in Varanasi, with several major trains, including the Vande Bharat Express, operating from the station. Railway authorities maintained that such minor issues are addressed promptly.

Officials also said that additional attention would be given to cleaning drainage systems and monitoring station infrastructure during the monsoon season to prevent similar incidents in the future.

The Railways have appealed to passengers to report any infrastructure-related issues immediately so that timely action can be taken.

articles.title: Wife Allegedly Injects Toilet Cleaner into Husband's IV Line After Failed Murder Bid, Trio Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling murder case has come to light from Telangana's Nizamabad district, where a woman allegedly used her nursing knowledge to inject toilet cleaning liquid into her husband's intravenous (IV) line after an earlier attempt to kill him by pushing him off a rooftop failed.

body.html:
A chilling murder case has come to light from Telangana's Nizamabad district, where a woman allegedly used her nursing knowledge to inject toilet cleaning liquid into her husband's intravenous (IV) line after an earlier attempt to kill him by pushing him off a rooftop failed. Police have arrested the woman, her alleged lover and another accomplice.

The incident was reported from Nyalakal village in Mopal mandal. The accused have been identified as Sandhya, her alleged lover Anil, and his friend Venkat Sai. The victim, Prashant, had recently returned from the Gulf, where he had been working to support his family.

According to police, Sandhya and Prashant had been facing marital disputes, allegedly over her extramarital relationship with Anil. Investigators claim the trio conspired to eliminate Prashant as they believed he had become an obstacle to their relationship.

Police alleged that the first attempt on Prashant's life was made after the accused got him heavily intoxicated. Anil and Venkat Sai allegedly assaulted him and pushed him off the rooftop of his house.

Despite suffering serious injuries, Prashant survived the fall. Investigators said the accused allegedly convinced him and others that he had accidentally fallen while under the influence of alcohol before admitting him to a private hospital for treatment.

Police said the conspiracy then entered a second phase at the hospital. While Prashant was undergoing treatment with an IV line inserted, Sandhya, who works as a nurse at a private hospital, allegedly injected toilet cleaning liquid into the IV line using a syringe. Investigators suspect the toxic substance caused his death.

The alleged murder came to light after Prashant's mother became suspicious about the circumstances surrounding his death and lodged a complaint on July 1.

During the investigation, police questioned the three accused and claimed to have uncovered the conspiracy. According to investigators, Venkat Sai admitted to helping push Prashant off the rooftop during the first attempt to kill him.

Sandhya, Anil and Venkat Sai have been arrested and produced before a court, which remanded them to judicial custody. Police said forensic examination is underway and further investigation into the case is in progress.

articles.title: Speeding Car Mows Down Two Women in Gujarat, Driver Flees After Abandoning Vehicle
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking hit-and-run incident has surfaced from Gujarat's Mahisagar district, where a speeding car allegedly ran over two women walking along a residential road before the driver fled the scene.

body.html:
A shocking hit-and-run incident has surfaced from Gujarat's Mahisagar district, where a speeding car allegedly ran over two women walking along a residential road before the driver fled the scene. The incident, captured on CCTV, has triggered outrage and renewed concerns over reckless driving.

The accident took place in Usmani Nagar Society near Mustafa Masjid in Lunawada town. CCTV footage shows the two women walking along the roadside when a speeding car approached from behind and crashed into them without warning.

The impact threw both women several feet into the air before they fell onto the road. Instead of stopping to help, the driver allegedly abandoned the vehicle at the scene and fled.

Local residents rushed to the victims' aid and shifted them to a nearby hospital. According to police, one of the women sustained serious injuries, while the other suffered minor injuries and is undergoing treatment.

Police reached the spot soon after receiving information about the accident and seized the abandoned vehicle. Investigators are analysing CCTV footage and other evidence to identify and trace the absconding driver.

Authorities said legal action will be initiated once the accused is arrested. The investigation into the hit-and-run case is underway.

The viral CCTV footage has once again raised concerns over rash driving and hit-and-run incidents, with many social media users demanding strict action against the accused driver.

articles.title: UP Sub-Inspector Suspended After Allegedly Stealing ₹20,000 From Truck Driver
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sub-inspector has been suspended after he was allegedly caught stealing ₹20,000 from a truck driver's cabin and was later assaulted by the driver on National Highway 34 in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur district.

body.html:
A sub-inspector has been suspended after he was allegedly caught stealing ₹20,000 from a truck driver's cabin and was later assaulted by the driver on National Highway 34 in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur district. Police have registered a case and ordered a departmental inquiry into the incident.

The incident reportedly took place around 9:30 am near the Yamuna bridge on NH-34. The accused has been identified as Sub-Inspector Girish Mishra, who was posted on court security duty in Hamirpur.

According to the complainant, truck driver Manish, he picked up the uniformed officer near the Ghata Khand area while returning after delivering a load of gravel, believing him to be a regular passenger. The journey continued until the truck reached near the Aliyapur toll plaza under the Sajeeti police station limits.

The driver alleged that he later found ₹20,000 missing from the truck's cabin and suspected the officer had concealed the cash inside his uniform. When confronted, the sub-inspector allegedly got off the truck and left the spot in a van parked near the toll plaza.

Police said the truck driver chased the van for nearly 13 kilometres. After the vehicle crossed the Yamuna bridge, the officer reportedly got down and was confronted by the driver. The complainant alleged that the missing cash was recovered from the officer's uniform during the confrontation.

A video of the incident, which has gone viral on social media, appears to show the truck driver slapping the uniformed officer multiple times. The officer's uniform was also reportedly torn during the scuffle as bystanders gathered at the scene.

Following the incident, local residents alerted the UP-112 emergency response service, after which the officer was taken to the local police station.

Circle Officer Yashpal Singh said a case has been registered at Kotwali Nagar Police Station based on the truck driver's complaint and the viral video. He confirmed that Sub-Inspector Girish Mishra has been suspended with immediate effect and that a departmental inquiry has been ordered.

Police said further legal and departmental action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.
